newsitem.title: USA: PartnerRe to sell $250 mln perpetual prfds.
newsitem.headline: PartnerRe to sell $250 mln perpetual prfds.

text.p: PartnerRe Ltd said on Thursday it has launched the sale of $250 million in perpetual preferred stock via joint lead managers Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co and Smith Barney Inc.
The offering, comprised of 10 million $25 shares, is expected to be priced with a dividend yield of eight percent, a PartnerRe official said.

It is made in connection with PartnerRe's acquisition of French reinsurer Societe Anonyme Francaise de Reassurances (SAFR), the company said. The units are rated "a1" by Moody's Investors Service and single-A by Standard & Poor's.
